name: Govee Lights
description:
Control your Govee lights from the top bar or Quick Settings.

Instant control over your local network (LAN), with the Govee cloud as a fallback. Power, brightness, colour temperature, colour, scenes, DIY scenes, snapshots, music modes and your own multi-light presets.

Needs a free Govee API key, stored in your keyring. Network use: the Govee cloud API and UDP on your local network (ports 4001–4003). Clipboard: Settings → About → Copy Debug Info copies a report to the clipboard when you click it.

Not affiliated with Govee.
